At /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/tests/ there should be Playwright screenshot files from previous comparisons. Read these image files to understand current visual state:

1. Read tests/final-live.png (live boldteq.com/our-works screenshot)
2. Read tests/final-local.png (local localhost:3001/our-works screenshot)  
3. Read tests/final-popup.png (popup screenshot)
4. Read tests/v3-live.png and tests/v3-local.png if they exist

Compare the two visually and list EVERY difference you can see between the live site and local site:
- Layout differences (sidebar position, width, card grid columns)
- Card design differences (borders, shadows, image heights, badges, hover effects)
- Typography differences
- Color differences
- Spacing/padding differences
- Missing elements
- Different behavior (popup, pagination, filters)
- Footer/CTA section differences

Be extremely detailed about WHAT is different and WHAT the correct value should be.

content.text: I'll help you analyze the screenshot files and compare the visual differences between the live site and local site. Let me start by reading these image files.

Perfect! I can now see all the screenshot comparisons. Let me analyze the visual differences between the live site (final-live.png and v3-live.png) and the local site (final-local.png and v3-local.png).

## Detailed Visual Comparison: Live vs Local Site

### **MAJOR LAYOUT DIFFERENCES**

1. **Grid Layout - Card Columns**
   - **LIVE**: 2-column grid layout for project cards
   - **LOCAL**: 2-column grid layout BUT appears narrower/different width distribution
   - The local site cards appear smaller and narrower overall

2. **Sidebar/Navigation**
   - **LIVE**: Has a visible left sidebar with category filters (Webflow, E-commerce, Web Design, etc.)
   - **LOCAL**: Sidebar is still visible but styling appears different

3. **Overall Page Width & Container**
   - **LIVE**: Appears to use full available width more efficiently
   - **LOCAL**: Page seems narrower, cards are smaller relative to viewport

### **HEADER & FILTER SECTION DIFFERENCES**

4. **Header Title Section**
   - **LIVE**: "Agency-Level Delivery, Without Hiring or Chaos" with subtitle visible clearly
   - **LOCAL**: Same title but appears to have different text rendering/sizing
   - **LOCAL** has visible filter buttons in a row (multiple button chips visible)

5. **Filter Buttons**
   - **LIVE**: Filter buttons are integrated but styled differently
   - **LOCAL**: Filter buttons are more prominent and visible as distinct white/light-colored chips

### **PROJECT CARD DIFFERENCES**

6. **Card Image Heights**
   - **LIVE**: Project card images appear taller/have more vertical space
   - **LOCAL**: Project card images appear shorter, with more white space below

7. **Card Borders & Shadows**
   - **LIVE**: Cards have subtle shadows, clean borders
   - **LOCAL**: Cards appear to have slightly different shadow treatment (may be more pronounced)

8. **Card Text/Description Area**
   - **LIVE**: Project titles and descriptions fill cards more uniformly
   - **LOCAL**: More white space visible below images in cards, text area appears smaller

9. **Project Card Badge/Label Positioning**
   - **LIVE**: "Webflow", "E-commerce", "Web Design" badges positioned at bottom corners of cards
   - **LOCAL**: Badge positioning appears consistent but spacing may differ

10. **Specific Card Visibility**
    - **LIVE**: More cards visible in viewport (appears to be ~8-9 cards visible)
    - **LOCAL**: Fewer cards visible, more scrolling required (appears to be ~5-6 cards visible)

### **SPACING & PADDING**

11. **Card Gaps/Gutters**
    - **LIVE**: Consistent, generous spacing between cards
    - **LOCAL**: Spacing may be different or cards are spaced further apart

12. **Page Padding/Margins**
    - **LIVE**: Balanced margins from viewport edges
    - **LOCAL**: Appears to have different left/right padding

### **TYPOGRAPHY DIFFERENCES**

13. **Title Text Rendering**
    - **LIVE**: "Agency-Level Delivery, Without Hiring or Chaos" appears in one style
    - **LOCAL**: Same text but rendering appears slightly different

14. **Filter Button Text**
    - **LIVE**: Filter buttons less visible/integrated
    - **LOCAL**: Filter buttons more visible with clear text labels

### **POPUP/MODAL DIFFERENCES** (final-popup.png)

15. **Modal Overlay & Styling**
    - Modal appears centered with project details
    - Pink/magenta color scheme visible for product showcase ("Salon Greats Beauts Without Dry Blow Dryer")
    - Close button (X) visible in top right
    - Modal shadow/backdrop appears consistent

### **FOOTER/CTA SECTION**

16. **CTA Button Section**
    - **LIVE**: "Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?" section with blue buttons
    - **LOCAL**: Same section visible with similar styling

17. **Footer**
    - **LIVE**: "Boldteq" branding with company info, appears to have proper spacing
    - **LOCAL**: Footer similar but may have layout differences

### **COLOR DIFFERENCES**

18. **Overall Color Tone**
    - **LIVE**: Lighter background, cleaner appearance
    - **LOCAL**: Appears to have slightly darker/grayed background in page container area

19. **Card Backgrounds**
    - **LIVE**: White card backgrounds
    - **LOCAL**: White backgrounds but may have slight tint

### **KEY FUNCTIONAL DIFFERENCES**

20. **Pagination Dots**
    - **LIVE**: Visible pagination dots at bottom of grid (blue dots)
    - **LOCAL**: Pagination dots also visible but may be positioned differently

21. **Side Navigation/Arrows**
    - **LIVE**: Left/right navigation arrows visible (circular, blue)
    - **LOCAL**: Navigation arrows may be positioned differently or styled differently

### **SUMMARY OF CRITICAL FIXES NEEDED**

**Must Fix:**
1. **Card Grid**: Increase card dimensions to match live site proportions
2. **Image Heights**: Increase project card image heights
3. **Page Container Width**: Ensure proper max-width and horizontal centering
4. **Card Spacing**: Adjust gap/gutter between cards to match live spacing
5. **Visible Cards**: Adjust responsive behavior so more cards fit in viewport
6. **Background Color**: Review page background color (appears slightly grayed in local)
7. **Filter Section**: Ensure filter buttons styling and layout matches live site

**Verify:**
- Card shadows and border-radius
- Typography sizes and weights
- Button styling consistency
- Modal positioning and sizing
- Footer layout

The local site appears to have a narrower container width or different card sizing that makes it less efficient use of the viewport space compared to the live site.
